newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks followed through on Friday's rally to move higher at the start of trading on Monday.
A steady bond market offered support, while high tech stocks followed through on last week's strength.
The Dow Industrials rose 17 at the start to 6,543. The Nasdaq Composite was up nine at 1,246, while the S&P Index rose one to 759.
The 30-year long bond was up 10/32 to yield 7.10 pct.
